sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Traditional White Stone Nath – Sparkling Nose Ring with Pearl Drop
sourceNotes.rawContent: Radiate timeless charm with this gold-toned nath, beautifully accented with shimmering white stones and a delicate pearl drop. This high-fashion piece is a perfect addition to your ethnic wardrobe. To preserve its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely after every wear.
